blocks.text: You can create Network segments in the Zscaler Admin Console. For a complete list of ranges and limits, see Ranges & Limitations.
To add a new Network segment:

blocks.item: Go to Private Access > VPN (for Legacy Apps) > Network Segments.

blocks.text: The Add Network Segment drawer opens.

blocks.item: In the Add Network Segment drawer:
Name: Enter a name for the Network segment.
Description: (Optional) Enter a description for the Network segment.
Users Access Application By: Select one of the following options:
IP Address: Select to associate an IP address or IP subnet with the Network segment.
FQDN: Select to associate an FQDN with the Network segment.
FQDN: Enter the FQDN to associate with the Network segment. To include all subdomains of a specific domain, use a wildcard character *.
Primary DNS Server: Enter the primary DNS server that is used to resolve the configured FQDN.
Secondary DNS Server: (Optional) Enter the secondary DNS server that is used to resolve the configured FQDN.
Matching DNS requests destined for the default adapter's secondary DNS server are routed by Zscaler Client Connector to the Network segment's configured secondary DNS server.
LAN IP Address/Subnet: Enter the IP address or IP subnet that you want to associate with the Network segment. You can enter multiple IP addresses or IP.
Network Connector Group: Select the Network Connector group you want to assign the Network segment to.
